title: Expedited hire sprint and evidence journal
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight playbook + running evidence journal for expedited hiring (2–4 week close) for small IC hires where hiring manager bandwidth is constrained and we need predictable first-30-day impact. Goal: reduce time-to-offer while preserving signal quality and minimize onboarding churn.

Context and when to use:
- Use for mid-level IC roles (SWE2 / ML infra / infra PM) where role scope is narrow and immediate contributor work can be scoped into 30-day deliverables.
- Not for senior IC (L4+) or leadership hires.
- Triggers: urgent capacity gap, runway-critical feature, or replace-on-leave.

Success metrics for the sprint (how we know it worked):
- Offer accepted within 21 days of first screen (target)
- Quality signal: interview average >= 3.7/5 across rubric OR pass on product/pairing sample
- Ramp indicators: first PR merged within 14 days; first independent bug fix in prod within 30 days OR clearly documented handoff and plan if infra setup blocks work

High-level flow and owner roles:
- Recruiter (sourcing + screen owner): schedule, prescreen, candidate experience notes.
- Hiring manager (role owner): final interview alignment, day-1 deliverable, scorecard signoff.
- Interview panel (rapid panel): 3 interviewers max, mix of cross-functional.
- People Ops lead (owner of sprint): triage cadence, scoreboard, offer coordination.

Pipeline/timeline (example 18-day sprint):
- Day 0–2: prescreen + take-home match test (if used)
- Day 3–6: interview loop (3 x 45m interviews across 2 days)
- Day 7: panel calibration + score review + decision
- Day 8: offer drafted + comp approved
- Day 9–14: negotiation and acceptance window
- Day 15–18: start date negotiation and onboarding prep

Interview rubric (quick scoring, 1–5):
- Problem solving (clarity of thought, decomposition): 1 poor -> 5 exemplary
- Technical correctness (algorithms, code, stats): 1 poor -> 5 exemplary
- System design / architecture (scope relevant to role): 1 poor -> 5 exemplary
- Operational judgement (monitoring, debugging, incident reasoning): 1 poor -> 5 exemplary
- Collaboration & communication (async + sync): 1 poor -> 5 exemplary
- Role fit / motivation (short written note required): Pass/Fail comment

Scoring guidance and decision rule:
- Average score across quantitative axes >= 3.7 -> green
- Any axis <= 2 -> auto-red unless mitigated by work sample or concrete compensating experience (documented in notes)
- Hiring manager must write a 3-sentence hire rationale for any offer (including risks and first-30-day plan)

Work sample / pairing alternative (optional but recommended):
- 2-hour pairing on a narrowly scoped bug/feature in a sandbox repo OR a 48-hour take-home with a strict rubric.
- Use this as decisive signal if in-person/loop scores are ambiguous.

Candidate evidence journal (structure for each candidate):
- Candidate id: (email stub)
- Source: (referrer / job board)
- Prescreen notes: bullet list
- Interview notes per interviewer: bullets and numeric score
- Take-home / pairing verdict: pass / fail + short note
- Red flags observed: bullets
- Hire rationale draft: (3 lines by HM)
- Offer outcome: accepted / declined / ghosted + timeline log

Rapid offer playbook (operational steps):
- Comp band check: recruiter confirms band and any sign-on/relocation needs before offer draft.
- Hiring manager approval: must sign off on final hire rationale and first-30-day deliverable.
- People Ops: prepare offer letter template, confirm manager is ready with onboarding tasks and buddy assignment.
- Legal/Finance: if comp deviates from band or a relocation/visa is required, loop in approvers early (target <48h resolution).

30-day onboarding checklist (minimalist, prioritized):
Day 0 (pre-start): account provisioning request submitted, PR job access list, first-week calendar drafted
Day 1: welcome sync + team intro (30m), set up dev environment (pair with buddy), share 30-day deliverable
Week 1: shadowing sessions (3x 1h), first small ticket assigned and paired, infra walkthrough
Week 2: independent work on first deliverable, weekly 1:1 established, 30-day progress check
Week 3: own a small feature/bug end-to-end, present short demo to team
Day 30: formal checkpoint (HM + People Ops): evidence of merged work or documented blockers and mitigation plan

Manager checklist for first 30 days (quick):
- Clear 30-day deliverable created and shared
- Buddy assigned with onboarding checklist and shadowing plan
- PR review cadence defined (expectation: 24–48h response)
- Access/escalation contacts listed and tested

Calibration and fairness notes:
- Panel must include at least one interviewer trained on bias-reduction (rotation list maintained by People Ops)
- Use structured question bank for core axes to improve consistency
- Keep interview notes factual and evidence-oriented (no speculation on cultural fit beyond specific behaviours)

Common risks and mitigations:
- Risk: rushing results in overstated skill signal. Mitigation: require passing work sample or pairing if any score variance >1.0 across interviewers.
- Risk: poor manager bandwidth for onboarding. Mitigation: gate offer until manager confirms buddy + 1:1 schedule.
- Risk: comp delays. Mitigation: pre-approval of comp band for sprint roles; involve finance on day 0 of sprint.

Unresolved questions / open items (working list):
- Should we standardize a single 48-hour take-home for all expedited roles? (OPINION: keep role-specific but standardized rubric)
- When to use signing bonus vs higher base for fast-closers? Need comp team guidance and precedent log.
- Who rotates bias-reduction interviewer each quarter? (Action: People Ops to propose rotation)

Action items (owners and timeline):
- Recruiter: create a 48-hour take-home template for infra roles by 2025-11-21 (Omar)
- People Ops: publish expedited rubric + rotation list for bias interviewer by 2025-11-07 (Leah)
- Hiring managers: create a first-30-day deliverable template and store in Confluence (Priya)

Notes to self / shorthand:
- Keep loop to 3 interviewers max, 45m each, avoid on-site loops for speed.
- Document every exception into candidate journal (we need traceability for later audits).
- Slack snippet template for offer: short PM-style bullets + comp summary to reduce back-and-forth.

Appendix: sample 30-day deliverable template (one-liner format):
- Outcome: ship monitoring for X service to reduce dup alerts by 40%
- Success criteria: unit tests + canary pipeline green, dashboard with baseline metrics
- Dependencies: access to infra A, mentor B, list of relevant repos

End of document.

(Internal draft — iterate. This doc lives as the working sprint journal; copy candidate evidence into Jira ticket PEOPLEOPS-421 for retention.)
